variants.optimizerInput: Telescope, Room Decor, Tier 2, Berry Blast. Build a compact but believable freestanding refractor telescope in three-quarter product view: berry-magenta enamel optical tube with cream trim, glass objective lens, focus knob, eyepiece, alt-azimuth yoke mount, sturdy brushed-metal tripod with three fully visible articulated legs and a small triangular accessory tray. Add subtle berry-red rubber grips and one small star-shaped adjustment cap as a decorative accent only. Premium studio lighting, grounded contact shadow, clear metal/glass/rubber separation, no readable text, logo, people or floating parts.

Telescope, Room Decor, Tier 2, Berry Blast. Create a child-friendly premium tabletop-to-floor telescope with a short wide optical tube, oversized front lens hood, visible focuser, compact pivot mount and three splayed legs joined by a real center brace. Use a strong cream-and-berry silhouette with deep plum metal hardware and one translucent pink lens accent, keeping accessories minimal so the telescope remains unmistakable at card size. Three-quarter isolated product, grounded shadow, no astronomy text, branding, room scene, impossible joints or flat icon styling.

Mini Aquarium, Room Decor, Tier 3, Galaxy Glow. Create a premium compact desktop aquarium in three-quarter product view: thick beveled glass tank with a dark-indigo structural base and matching lid, visible rear filter housing, small intake tube and soft concealed light strip. Inside, use layered dark gravel, translucent aqua stones, sculptural aquatic plants and a few abstract orbit-ring rock ornaments suggesting Galaxy Glow without text or branded imagery. Include realistic waterline, glass refraction, subtle bubbles, caustic light and grounded base shadow; keep the tank physically plausible and readable at 600x600.

Mini Aquarium, Room Decor, Tier 3, Galaxy Glow. Design a distinctive rounded-corner rectangular aquarium with a broad navy pedestal base, crystal-clear glass walls, one compact side filter and a simple moonlike rock arch over violet-blue gravel with three tall aquatic plants and a controlled bubble column. Add restrained cyan/violet galaxy rim lighting and tiny star-like highlights only as reflected light, not flat decals. Keep the silhouette clean, the interior uncluttered and the construction believable in three-quarter isolated product view, with no text, logos, fish characters, room scene or floating hardware.
